uncertainties.note: Self-deprecating admission of repeated defeats, reacted to with surprise in 5945, then resolved into 'Yassaba Jin cannot afford to lose today' (5947, third person). Read as Yassaba Jin's own boast/lament rather than someone else describing him, since he names himself in 5947; not stated as certain because no speaker tag exists.

'Black Southern Cross' (5952) is Gain Bijou's locked nickname (character_names_021.json) and was already used the same way as an enemy epithet thrown at him in batch_04398.json ('Black Southern Cross! I'll bring your head back to Siberia...'). Read the same way here: Yassaba Jin (Siberian Railway) taunts an opponent implied to be Gain Bijou for using an Overman instead of sniping; the addressee is not named in-line, so no name was written into the visible text.
Unnamed opponent recognized as familiar ('I remember you!'); no identity guessed. 5958's warning ('don't take the bait') is unattributed but plausibly a teammate of whoever is being taunted.
'Isamu' matches the locked short form for Isamu Alva Dyson (sources.json); gender/identity already established in the glossary, not inferred here.
Untimed post-battle conference rows (no <ab()>/<off()> in the source from 5978 through 6044, matching the pattern already documented for batch_02375.json). Speakers are not tagged; left unattributed.

'スカブ知性体説' (book 71) has no existing corpus/glossary entry; rendered literally as 'Scub Sentience Theory' and proposed in the accompanying glossary_proposals file. 'Scub' itself (book 69) follows the already-locked 'Scub Coral' short form used in character_names_021.json (Dr. Bear's role text).

'クダンの限界' (book 77) researched via WebSearch: the Eureka Seven fandom wiki's own page title is 'Limit of Questions' (not a literal 'Kudan' rendering); used per the corpus rule that the wiki wins over a literal/corpus guess. Proposed in the glossary_proposals file since no prior project lock was found.

Source breaks the term itself with an ellipsis (クダンの……限界？). Rendered as 'Limit of... Questions?' inside the same book(77) span to keep the dramatic pause while still reading as the locked-choice term; flagged as an imperfect fit for orchestrator review.

アーキタイプ (book 67, 'Archetype') has no existing project glossary entry; it is the Eureka Seven franchise's own official English term (confirmed via WebSearch of eurekaseven.fandom.com/wiki/Archetype) and is proposed in the glossary_proposals file.

validation.fit: Longest row (06015) compressed to 107 visible characters (from a literal ~150) without dropping the end of the sentence; all others fit with room to spare.
validation.ascii: ASCII-only; no lowercase j/q outside the locked names Jamil/Jin/Jurgens/Bijou.
